checks.name: Not configured: status says so, and narration is refused with the reason (no job, no sound)

detail.detail: neither PF_VOICE_PYTHON nor PF_SPEECH_PYTHON is set: no voice engine is configured

checks.name: Voice engine answers a probe and is reported with its version
The reviewed voice model is listed with licence, exact size and per-file state
Model files were already present; size and SHA-256 of each were verified again
Ready state names the device and says what has not been qualified
Three Hebrew sentences were spoken by jobs and became audio assets
Each asset is ordinary 48 kHz audio of a plausible length (0.05–0.3 s per character)
Each asset records its recipe: engine, model revisions, language, the text and the pointed text that was spoken, the seed, built-in voice, watermark
The three takes sit on the timeline one after another
Round trip: the local recogniser recovers at least 60% of the words from the generated speech

Reference voice: a recording under 5 seconds is refused
Reference voice: with the owner's statement the job runs, and the asset records the reference, the speaker, the statement, who made it and when
Cancel stops a running narration and adds nothing to the library
Script: the text is split into its three sentences, one job each, in order
Script: sentences are placed one after another with the gap, on one track; a canceled sentence leaves no hole
Script: more than 60 sentences in one request is refused before any job
Editor: the Sound tab offers narration when it is set up; typing a sentence and pressing the button adds a narration clip

Editor: a clip under 5 seconds is not offered as a reference; a longer one needs the speaker's name and the ticked statement before the button works; the result records them and the owner as the one who stated it
The timeline with the narration exports with audible sound of the expected length
